blocks.text: Queensborough Middle School (833 Salter St) is a middle school in Queensborough. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.
Queensborough homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Queensborough, September 2026. Detached houses: 41 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 2% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 72 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 34.2 listed, about 17.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 41 sold over 4 months against an average of 77.0 listed, about 7.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 14 sold.
